selected_inputs: publisher repositories through the session git proxy and raw.githubusercontent.com (ingest performed in the stage; copies carried in)

args: node --check tests/reference/ingress.mjs && sh -n tests/reference/run-ingress-checks.sh && node tests/reference/ingress.mjs plan-check --routes fixtures/reference/ROUTES.json --map REFERENCE-AUTHORITY.md --graph design/environment-map/graph.json

T=$(mktemp -d) && node tests/reference/ingress.mjs verify --routes fixtures/reference/ROUTES.json --corpus fixtures/reference --register fixtures/reference/REGISTER.json --out $T/verify.json && grep -q '"verdict": "PASS"' $T/verify.json && node -e 'const r=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("fixtures/reference/REGISTER.json"));if(r.totals.ingested!==r.totals.files||r.totals.pin_mismatch!==0)process.exit(1);for(const f of r.files){if(!f.commit||!f.sha256||!f.git_blob_sha1||!f.fetched)process.exit(1)}console.log("register:",JSON.stringify(r.totals))'

for f in $(find fixtures/reference -type f | sort); do case $f in fixtures/reference/README.md|fixtures/reference/ROUTES.json|fixtures/reference/REGISTER.json|fixtures/reference/published/*|fixtures/reference/sources/*) ;; *) echo "unexpected $f"; exit 1;; esac; done; n=$(find fixtures/reference/published fixtures/reference/sources -type f | wc -l); r=$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("fixtures/reference/REGISTER.json")).totals.ingested)'); [ "$n" = "$r" ] && echo "$n copies == register"

grep -q 'REPRODUCIBILITY PIN' fixtures/reference/README.md && grep -q 'never the current authority' fixtures/reference/README.md && ! grep -rqiE 'require\(|from [\"'\''](?!node:)' tests/reference/ingress.mjs
